chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from Ays ibn al-Qasim
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the leopards and the predatory birds, can one seek trade in them? He (peace be upon him) said: Yes.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to buy and sell leopards and predatory birds in Islam?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) confirms the permissibility (*ibahah*) of trading in leopards and predatory birds, indicating that their status as wild beasts does not inherently prohibit commercial exchange. This ruling reflects the early juristic view that such animals are considered *mal* (property/wealth) and thus valid subjects of sale, provided they are not explicitly forbidden by other textual evidence. The context highlights the practical application of property rights in early Shia jurisprudence regarding livestock and game.
